source_text: Proponents of deferring circumcision until adulthood highlight it as a form of iatrogenic injury, removing functional foreskin tissue—estimated at 30-50 cm² in adulthood—that serves protective, sensory, and immunological roles, without compensating medical necessity for newborns in low-risk settings.
